verified_facts.text: Thompson Nashville is a boutique hotel in The Gulch neighborhood near Broadway.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thompson Nashville, our boutique hotel located in The Gulch neighborhood near Broadway, sets the stage for your downtown Nashville experience.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is just steps from Broadway's honky-tonks, Bridgestone Arena, Music Row, the Frist Art Museum and Geodis Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Nashville hotel is located just steps from art and culture — Broadway’s Honky Tonks, Bridgestone Arena, Music Row, the Frist Art Museum, Geodis Park, and endless boutiques.

verified_facts.text: Every guest room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, sliding barn doors and rainfall showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in the city through the floor-to-ceiling windows in each of our luxury hotel’s 224 guest rooms and suites, where sliding barn doors, chic mid-century-inspired furnishings and rainfall showers

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature king beds with Sferra linens and hardwood floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: unwind in the comforts of your room featuring a king bed with luxury Sferra linens, hardwood floors, and a refreshing rainfall shower.

verified_facts.text: Marsh House, on the ground floor, highlights responsibly sourced seafood and Southern-inspired cuisine with a raw bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the ground floor, Marsh House highlights responsibly sourced seafood and Southern-inspired cuisine, with a seasonal menu and standout raw bar.

verified_facts.text: Marsh House's wine list features more than 400 labels.
verified_facts.excerpt: The wine list features more than 400 labels.

verified_facts.text: Marsh House runs a weekday oyster happy hour.
verified_facts.excerpt: weekday happy hour includes $1.50 oysters Monday through Friday from 5:00 to 7:00 PM in The Gulch.

verified_facts.text: L.A. Jackson, on the top floor, is an indoor-outdoor rooftop bar with views of The Gulch, craft cocktails and shareable bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Head to the top floor of Thompson Nashville, where L.A. Jackson pairs indoor and outdoor rooftop views of The Gulch with craft cocktails, local and regional beers, and shareable bites.

verified_facts.text: DJs play at L.A. Jackson on select weekends, and it is 21 and over.
verified_facts.excerpt: DJs set the tone on select weekends. Primarily walk-in, with tables available to reserve for larger groups and special events. 21 and over.

verified_facts.text: Killebrew Coffee is the lobby-level coffee shop, with a pastry counter.
verified_facts.excerpt: Start your day off in our boutique hotel’s lobby-level coffee shop, Killebrew Coffee, in The Gulch.

verified_facts.text: In-room dining from Marsh House is available day, night and overnight.
verified_facts.excerpt: Day or night, or even overnight, select from an enticing assortment of sustainable, Southern-flare cuisine.

verified_facts.text: Dogs are welcome at no additional charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: We welcome dogs at no additional charge.

verified_facts.text: A daily destination fee is applied to each room.
verified_facts.excerpt: A daily destination fee of $30.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

verified_facts.text: Each floor has hydration stations with filtered sparkling and still water.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hydration stations on each floor with filtered sparkling and still water.

verified_facts.text: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance with in-and-out privileges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Valet parking is available at our downtown Nashville hotel entrance, including in-and-out privileges.

verified_facts.text: Nashville International Airport is 9 miles from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Getting here is easy, with BNA Airport only 9 miles from our Nashville hotel in The Gulch.

verified_facts.text: The Thompson Nashville was the brand's first hotel in the South.
verified_facts.excerpt: One of the first luxury hotels in The Gulch neighborhood, the Thompson Nashville was the brand’s first hotel in the South.

verified_facts.text: The hotel rises 12 stories.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Thompson Nashville rises 12 stories above the intersection between 11th Avenue South and 12th Avenue South

verified_facts.text: The lobby floor is made from reclaimed wood from the neighborhood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thompson Nashville has some sustainable elements, including the lobby floor, which is made from reclaimed wood from the neighborhood.

verified_facts.text: The famous wings mural is just across the street from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Gulch is one of the best places to take a mural tour in Nashville—the famous wings are just across the street from the Thompson.

verified_facts.text: Guest room minibars are stocked with local treats including Tennessee spirits, and rooms have a cocktail shaker.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guest room mini bars are stocked with local treats and ingredients, including Tennessee spirits. You can use the cocktail shaker in your room to craft your own perfect drink

verified_facts.text: Kids stay free, cribs can be requested and connecting rooms are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kids stay free at the Thompson Nashville, and guests can request cribs if necessary. There are also connecting rooms available for older children or multi-generational families.

verified_facts.text: Hotel decor is midcentury-modern inspired, with natural wood and neutral colors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel decor is midcentury-modern–inspired, which means you’ll be treated to minimalist interiors with lots of natural wood and neutral colors

verified_facts.text: Hotel happenings include whisky tastings, guided wellness classes and acoustic sets at Marsh House.
verified_facts.excerpt: From rooftop soirées with DJs and skyline views at L.A. Jackson to intimate acoustic sets in the sultry ambiance of The Marsh House, there's always something happening. Enjoy exclusive whisky tastings, guided wellness classes

subjective.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls it the hippest design hotel in the Gulch.
subjective.reason: the hotel's own opinion or praise; keep out of facts
